title: Just OK. Worth the price of admission for the Pop Rides, otherwise underwhelming.
text: To all of the people saying "you easily get $30 worth of stuff" so it's worth it. No. The promise of the boxes is $50-$60 worth of stuff so just because it is worth what you paid, does not make it a deal. I'd rather pay $30 for things I know I want than just be handed 4 things and be told it's $30. Overall, the box was good, just not what you expect with the collector corps box. The taco stand was cheap, the luggage tag was fine, and the keychain was nice but nothing new and rather cheap as well. A second pop or a T-Shirt would have made the box worth it, as it's its just OK. I renewed my subscription when Amazon took it over expecting it to get better, but so far they're no different. I'll probably sit out the venom one.
label: neutral
